meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: Claude 会把 Telegram 适配器、配对与格式化辅助代码及测试从 channels 分支复制进项目并注册,安装 @chat-adapter/telegram、跑测试,再用 4 位配对码绑定你的 Telegram 聊天。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目添加 Telegram 通道时触发;通常在 /setup 流程中或之后运行,过程里需要你在 @BotFather 手动创建机器人并提供 token。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 通道接入这个项目
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑测试

say.text: 给我 4 位配对码,我发到这个机器人聊天里
say.note: 运行 pair-telegram,匹配即完成绑定

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Telegram adapter, its pairing and formatting helpers and tests from the channels branch, registers the channel, installs @chat-adapter/telegram, builds, runs tests, then pairs your Telegram chat with a 4-digit code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Telegram channel to the project; usually run during or after /setup, and you create the bot in @BotFather yourself and supply its token.

say_en.text: Add the Telegram channel to this project
say_en.note: copies adapter, installs dep, runs tests

say_en.text: My bot token from BotFather is 123456:ABC...
Give me the 4-digit pairing code to send to the bot
